description: Virtual H&E false coloring of paired two-channel TIFF slice stacks (MegaSpim All_Channels exports): per-slice restoration (RL deconvolution, FFT destripe, rolling-ball background, optional CLAHE) + Beer-Lambert falsecolor rendering (Liu Lab falsecolor package, per-plane tile flat-field) with optional background masking and RGB post-sharpening.
notes_for_agents: Production entry is falsecolor_batch. Run with the micromamba yifu env python only (the falsecolor package lives in that env).
Channel convention: nuclei_channel=1, cyto_channel=0 (ch1 nuclear stain, ch0 cytoplasm/autofluorescence). Verify per sample before batch runs.

All-default invocation = current latest method: he_preprocess (deconv rl sigma 1.2 x10 -> destripe fft 0.85 -> rolling_ball r5) + asymmetric background subtract (nuc 3x, cyto 1x) + pre-color sharpen 0.05 + per-plane tile flat-field (256 px, nuc 0.7 / cyto 2.6) + HE palette.

--flatfield (default on) REQUIRES --backend gpu (numba CUDA). On GPU-less hosts the backend silently falls back to cpu and the run then aborts on the flatfield check -- pass --no-flatfield (and tune nuc/cyto_normfactor) instead.
Resume is default-on: non-empty existing outputs are skipped; a _falsecolor_progress.json is kept in the output dir.

For production runs submit via PM wrap: `python -m pipeline_modules.harness wrap --sample-dir <dir> --title <ASCII title> -- <command>`. The program prints [done/total] lines but no PROGRESS protocol lines (no progress bar; heartbeat + log tail still tracked). Wrap runs the child with cwd=sample-dir, so set PYTHONPATH=<repo root> or run from the repo root.
Input discovery expects <prefix>_ch<N>.tif(f) pairs; output goes to <input_dir>_FalseColor (unless --output_dir) as <prefix>_HE.tif RGB uint8 slices.

entrypoints.description: Batch virtual H&E conversion of paired ch0/ch1 TIFF slices (production entry).

input_dir.description: Directory containing <prefix>_ch0/_ch1 TIFF pairs (e.g. All_Channels export)

backend.description: gpu=rapidFalseColor (numba CUDA), cpu=falseColor; auto-falls back to cpu when CUDA is unavailable

workers.description: Parallel worker processes; preprocess is CPU-bound, pair with OMP_NUM_THREADS=1-2

he_preprocess.description: Per-slice chain: RL deconvolution (deconv_backend rl, sigma 1.2, iterations 10) -> FFT destripe (strength 0.85, notch 2.0, orientation horizontal) -> rolling ball r5 on nuclei; see --deconv_*/--destripe_*/--rolling_ball_radius flags

flatfield.description: Per-plane tile-median flat-field (tile 256, nuc scale 0.7, cyto scale 2.6); requires gpu backend; replaces global normfactors

bg_nuc_factor.description: Subtract factor*background from nuclei before coloring (with flatfield)

bg_cyto_factor.description: Subtract factor*background from cyto before coloring (with flatfield)

nuc_normfactor.description: Global nuclei normalization (ignored when flatfield on)

cyto_normfactor.description: Global cyto normalization (ignored when flatfield on)

mask_background.description: Post-color background masking: none | channels | rgb | channels+rgb | hsv (see --background_threshold/--white_threshold/--pale_signal_threshold/--hsv_* companions)

fill_holes.description: Restore color inside masked holes within tissue

test.description: Process only the first N pairs (smoke test)

middle.description: Process N pairs from the center of the stack

resume.description: Skip slices whose output already exists

entrypoints.description: Single-slice preprocess + HE render without UI (or --preview to hand off to the napari preview); also exports preprocessed nuclei/cyto and an Otsu nuclei mask.
Interactive napari preview: nuclei/seg/cyto/HE layers with live parameter sliders.
Interactive or grid sweep of colleague-style parameters (flatfield scales, bg factors, sharpen alpha).
